correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exact definition: 14 directed-arc vertices from seven fully bidirected fan edges; a face is an arc set with indegrees/outdegrees <=1 and no directed cycles, including 2-cycles. Independent direct enumeration returned 160 nonempty faces, f=(14,56,70,20). Regenerated the specified 14-index staged matching: 74 pairs, 402 directed Hasse incidences, complete acyclic topological sort, critical cells (one vertex,nine triangles,two tetrahedra). Exact integral reduction gives zero 9x2 Morse boundary, so three-cell attaching maps vanish in pi_2 of the nine-S2 wedge and the integral homotopy wedge follows. Independent rational rank-18 top boundary/trace on its 2D kernel gave rho trace H3=0, reduced H2=1, so rational eigenspace multiplicities H2=(5,4), H3=(1,1). No integral equivariant splitting is asserted.
